quest.ae2.description.12: &7The &a&lInfinite Storage&r&7 can store way too much items.
quest.ae2.description.21: &7The &a&lInfinite Fluid Storage&r&7 can store way too much fluids.
quest.ae2.description.22: &7The Crafter is a block that crafts items with patterns. It can take speed upgrades to increase the crafting speed.
quest.ae2.description.24: &7The &a&lIron Crafter&r&7 is an upgrade of a Crafter.
quest.ae2.description.25: &7It crafts faster and have &f&l27&r&7 slots for patterns.
quest.ae2.description.26: &7The &a&lGold Crafter&r&7 is an upgrade of an &a&lIron Crafter&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.27: &7It crafts faster and have &f&l45&r&7 slots for patterns.
quest.ae2.description.28: &7The &a&lDiamond Crafter&r&7 is an upgrade of a &a&lGold Crafter&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.29: &7It crafts faster and have &f&l63&r&7 slots for patterns.
quest.ae2.description.30: &7The &a&lNetherite Crafter&r&7 is an upgrade of a &a&lDiamond Crafter&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.31: &7It crafts faster and have &f&l81&r&7 slots for patterns.
quest.ae2.description.32: &7The &a&lMachine Casing&r&7 is a block that is used to craft the various &b&lRefined Storage&r&7 devices.
quest.ae2.description.33: &7The Grid is a block that allows access to the items in the storage network.
quest.ae2.description.34: &7The &a&lCrafting Grid&r&7 is the same as a regular Grid, but has a crafting inventory.
quest.ae2.description.35: &7The &a&lPattern Grid&r&7 is the same as a regular Grid, but also allows for the creation of patterns.
quest.ae2.description.36: &7The &a&lFluid Grid&r&7 is the same as a regular Grid, but is used for viewing fluids in the fluid storage of your storage network.
quest.ae2.description.37: &7The &a&lCrafter Manager&r&7 is a block that allows you to see all your patterns in one GUI.
quest.ae2.description.38: &7The &a&lCrafting Monitor&r&7 is a block that shows all the current running crafting tasks and how long they have been running.
quest.ae2.description.39: &7The &a&lDisk Drive&r&7 is the block in which you store storage disks or fluid storage disks.
quest.ae2.description.40: &7The Controller is the core of the &b&lRefined Storage&r&7 network. You need to connect all the &b&lRefined Storage&r&7 devices to this block.
quest.ae2.description.41: &7The Interface is a block that acts as a combination of the Importer and the Exporter.
quest.ae2.description.42: &7The &a&lFluid Interface&r&7 is the same as an Interface but for fluids.
quest.ae2.description.43: &7The &a&lExternal Storage&r&7 is a block that provides the storage network with storage of the inventory or fluid tank in front of the device.
quest.ae2.description.44: &7The Importer imports items or fluids from an inventory in front of the block and inserts it in the storage network (if there is space).
quest.ae2.description.45: &7The Exporter extracts items or fluids from the storage network and inserts it in the inventory or tank in front of it.
quest.ae2.description.46: &7The &a&lWireless Transmitter&r&7 is used to send signals to wireless network items in &b&lRefined Storage&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.47: &7The &a&lRange Upgrade&r&7 increases the range of the &a&lWireless Transmitter&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.48: &7The &a&lInfinity Range Booster&r&7 give you an infinite range in the &a&lWireless Transmitter&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.49: &7The &a&lDimension Card&r&7 give you an infinite range and an interdimensional range in the &a&lWireless Transmitter&r&7.
quest.ae2.description.50: &7The &a&lNetwork Receiver&r&7 is the block that receives a signal from the &a&lNetwork Transmitter&r&7.
quest.alola.description.2: &7&d&lCosmoem&r&7 evolves at level &f&l53&r&7, if it's daytime you get &d&lSolgaleo&r&7
quest.alola.description.3: &7&d&lCosmoem&r&7 evolves at level &f&l53&r&7, if it's nighttime you get &d&lLunala&r&7
quest.alola.description.4: &7Use &f&l4&r&7 &a&lNetherite Scraps&r&7 on the mystery block to spawn several &d&lMeltan&r&7.
quest.alola.description.5: &7&c&lBe careful though, there is a high chance the spawns are dittos!&r&7
quest.alola.description.6: &7Evolve meltan by feeding it &f&l400&r&7 Iron nuggets!
quest.alola.description.7: &7An iron ingot counts as &f&l9&r&7 Iron nuggets while an Iron block counts as &f&l81&r&7!
quest.arena.subtitle.1: Here are the 84 badges you need to collect! Once you've collected them, you'll have finished the game! To get them, all you have to do is conquer the 3 battle towers you'll find wandering around overworld! Good luck to you! You can use /locate pixelmon:tower_water or /locate pixelmon:tower_darkness but you need creative mode
quest.dimensions.description.1: &7Craft a &a&lEnd Cake&r&7 to access to the End.
quest.dimensions.description.2: &7&c&lWarning: Take a Waystone for the return journey.&r&7
quest.extended_crafting.description.1: &7The &a&lBasic Crafting Table&r&7 is mainly used to craft &a&lSolar Panel&r&7 from &a&lEnvironmental Energy&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.2: &7You can automate the &a&lBasic Crafting Table&r&7 with it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.3: &7The Table will grab items in an inventory on top of it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.4: &7&a&lBasic Component&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lBasic Catalyst&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.5: &7&a&lBasic Catalyst&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lBasic Crafting Table&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.6: &7The &a&lAdvanced Crafting Table&r&7 is mainly used to craft &a&lSolar Panel&r&7 from &a&lSolar Flux&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.7: &7You can automate the &a&lAdvanced Crafting Table&r&7 with it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.8: &7The Table will grab items in an inventory on top of it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.9: &7&a&lAdvanced Component&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lAdvanced Catalyst&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.10: &7&a&lAdvanced Catalyst&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lAdvanced Crafting Table&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.11: &7The &a&lElite Crafting Table&r&7 is used to craft the Quarkotron controller and some creative items.
quest.extended_crafting.description.12: &7You can automate the &a&lElite Crafting Table&r&7 with it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.13: &7The Table will grab items in an inventory on top of it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.14: &7&a&lElite Component&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lElite Catalyst&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.15: &7&a&lElite Catalyst&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lElite Crafting Table&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.16: &7The &a&lUltimate Crafting Table&r&7 is mainly used to craft creative items.
quest.extended_crafting.description.17: &7You can automate the &a&lUltimate Crafting Table&r&7 with it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.18: &7The Table will grab items in an inventory on top of it.
quest.extended_crafting.description.19: &7&a&lUltimate Component&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lUltimate Catalyst&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.20: &7&a&lUltimate Catalyst&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lUltimate Crafting Table&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.21: &7The &a&lCrystaltine Component&r&7 is mainly used to craft the automation version of &a&lExtended Table&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.22: &7The &a&lRedstone Component&r&7 is mainly used to craft the automation version of &a&lExtended Table&r&7.
quest.extended_crafting.description.23: &7The &a&lEnder Crafter&r&7 work with &a&lEnder Alternator&r&7, the more you have, the fastest it crafts.
quest.extended_crafting.description.24: &7The max size is 7x7x7 with the Crafter at the center.
quest.extended_crafting.description.25: &7The &a&lCrafting Core&r&7, with the Pedestal, is used to craft the &a&lCreative Essence&r&7 and other end game things.
quest.extended_crafting.description.26: &7The &a&lQuantum Compressor&r&7 is only used to craft &d&lSingularities&r&7.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.2: &7You can mine a vein of blocks of the same type with &a&lOre Excavation&r&7 (bind in options).
quest.for_the_beginning.description.3: &7Crouch down quickly near a sapling to make it grow faster.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.4: &7Use Crook to destroy leaves and collect Silkworm.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.5: &7Then use Silkworm on leaves to create &a&lInfesting Leaves&r&7.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.6: &7Finally destroy &a&lInfesting Leaves&r&7 with Crook to collect Strings.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.7: &7Place the Mesh on the Sieve. The better the mesh, the more loot you will get.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.8: &7Thanks to the sieve you will get your first resources. You can sieve dirt, sand, gravel and others...
quest.for_the_beginning.description.9: &7The &a&lHeavy Sieve&r&7 is used to sift the compressed blocks. This will save you time.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.10: &7The barrel allows you to transform blocks from items or liquid.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.12: &7Use silkworm and sapling on barrel to obtain dirt.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.13: &7Use water and dust on barrel to obtain clay.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.14: &7Put the lava over a water barrel and craft the void portal to go into overworld.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.15: &7The hammer transforms the basic blocks, example:
quest.for_the_beginning.description.19: &7To transform the blocks more quickly, use the &a&lCompressed Hammer&r&7. It transforms compressed blocks.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.20: &7Use Polymorph to craft compressed by &6&lEx Compressum&r&7 mod.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.21: &7This crucible is an improvement of the wooden crucible which allows to obtain lava.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.22: &7Put heat source under it like torch.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.23: &7No more manual sifting. The &a&lAuto Sieve&r&7 will demand energy and automatically sift for you.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.24: &7The auto hammer will transform the blocks for you in exchange of energy.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.25: &7It is a miniature and automatic culture farm.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.26: &7You will need a lot of cobblestone for your early game.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.28: &7You can capture NPCs by shooting with the cannon on the NPC (keep the right click).
quest.for_the_beginning.description.29: &7You then throw the pokeball to make the NPC appear
quest.for_the_beginning.description.31: Thank you for playing &5PixelGO &7- &3To the Sky.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.32: &7Here are a few commands to help you on your way.
quest.for_the_beginning.description.36: &7/csell all (Sells the items in your inventory)
quest.fossils.description.1: &7Place your fossils in the machine and wait.
quest.fossils.description.2: &7When the machine has processed the fossil, place a ball into it.
quest.fossils.description.4: &7There are &f&l15&r&7 fossils to discover from around the world so make sure to go explore
quest.fossils.description.14: &7This covered fossil can be found below Y33 in mountainous biomes
quest.fossils.description.16: &7There's nothing wrong with showing off your discoveries!
quest.Galar.description.1: &7Use the &a&lReins of Unity&r&7 on &d&lCalyrex&r&7 to fuse it with &d&lGlastrier&r&7 or &d&lSpectrier&r&7, whichever is first in the party list
quest.Galar.description.4: &7&d&lKubfu&r&7 evolves into &a&lUrshifu Single&r&7/&a&lRapid Strike Style&r&7 by right-clicking on it at the top of the &a&lTower of Darkness&r&7, in front of the &a&lScroll of Darkness&r&7 or right-clicking on it at the top of the &a&lTower of Waters&r&7, in front of the &a&lScroll of Waters&r&7.
quest.Galar.description.7: &7Stage &f&l1&r&7 - Defeat or Capture an &a&lAlter Textured Pokemon&r&7
quest.Galar.description.8: &7Stage &f&l2&r&7 - Continue until a &a&lGalarian Articuno&r&7 spawns (As long as you have the quest, there's a chance it can spawn when defeating/capturing)
quest.Galar.description.11: &7Stage &f&l1&r&7 - Defeat or Capture an &a&lAshen Textured Pokemon&r&7
quest.Galar.description.12: &7Stage &f&l2&r&7 - Continue until a &a&lGalarian Moltres&r&7 spawns (As long as you have the quest, there's a chance it can spawn when defeating/capturing)
quest.Galar.description.15: &7Stage &f&l1&r&7 - Defeat or Capture a &a&lStrike Textured Pokemon&r&7
quest.Galar.description.16: &7Stage &f&l2&r&7 - Continue until a &a&lGalarian Zapdos&r&7 spawns (As long as you have the quest, there's a chance it can spawn when defeating/capturing)
quest.hoenn.description.7: &7A Meteorite is an item that can change a &d&lDeoxys&r&7's form when used on the &d&lDeoxys&r&7. It can only be used on a &d&lDeoxys&r&7 owned by the player using the Meteorite. The Meteorite can be used an infinite number of times to change a &d&lDeoxys&r&7's form.
quest.hoenn.description.8: &7Find this while fishing with a super rod orquest.johto exploring mineshafts
quest.hoenn.description.9: &7Find this while fishing with a super rod or exploring mineshafts
quest.hoenn.description.10: &7Right click on the ground while holding some shards to start building the orb.
quest.hoenn.description.11: &7You'll need &f&l10&r&7 shards to make an orb
quest.hoenn.description.12: &7Then you'll be able to transform &d&lGroudon&r&7 into it's primal form!
quest.hoenn.description.13: &7Right click on the ground while holding some shards to start building the orb.
quest.hoenn.description.14: &7You'll need &f&l10&r&7 shards to make an orb
quest.hoenn.description.15: &7Then you'll be able to transform &d&lKyogre&r&7 into it's primal form!
quest.hoenn.description.16: &7&d&lRotom&r&7 has &f&l6&r&7 forms, each &d&lRotom&r&7 form is obtained by throwing &d&lRotom&r&7's Poké Ball at certain blocks:
quest.hoenn.description.17: &7&l- &7Normal (Electric/Ghost) - Throw at the last used block again.
quest.johto.description.1: &7After the bell is placed on the underside of a block, each dawn of the Minecraft day cycle, the bell will have a &f&l1&r&7% chance to begin ringing and glowing. When the bell activates the bell will have a guaranteed spawn for its respective legendary when the day reaches dusk
quest.johto.description.2: &7After the bell is placed on the underside of a block, each dawn of the Minecraft day cycle, the bell will have a &f&l1&r&7% chance to begin ringing and glowing. When the bell activates the bell will have a guaranteed spawn for its respective legendary when the day reaches dusk
quest.johto.description.3: &7Right click the &a&lIlex Shrine&r&7 with a GS ball to summon a &d&lCelebi&r&7
quest.kalos.description.1: &7Construct a &d&lZygarde&r&7 in the Reassembly unit. You can add more cores and cell later to improve it's move set and strength!
quest.kalos.description.2: &7You'll need this later to construct your own &d&lZygarde&r&7
quest.kalos.description.3: &7You will need this to collect &d&lZygarde&r&7 cells and cores. Right click to add them to this device
quest.kalos.description.4: &7Both the cells and cores can spawn in any biome, on logs, leaves and grass blocks. It is strongly recommended to explore new areas when looking for zygarde cells, as they are only able to spawn in chunks that have been loaded for a total of &f&l30&r&7 minutes or less.
quest.kanto.description.2: &7Get your hands on a &a&lCloning Machine&r&7 and insert a &d&lMew&r&7
quest.kanto.description.4: &7Final step...Use the Orb on the shrine and catch the &d&lZapdos&r&7!
quest.kanto.description.5: &7To charge your orb, craft it with either a Waterstone, Thunderstone or Firestone, then defeat some Pokémon
quest.kanto.description.6: &7Final step...Use the Orb on the shrine and catch the &d&lArticuno&r&7!
quest.kanto.description.7: &7Final step...Use the Orb on the shrine and catch the &d&lMoltres&r&7!
quest.kanto.description.8: &7Time to find a &a&lFrozen Shrine&r&7 in an &a&lIcy Biome&r&7
quest.kanto.description.9: &7Time to find a &a&lStatic Shrine&r&7 in a &a&lSavannah Biome&r&7
quest.kanto.description.10: &7Time to find a &a&lFiery Shrine&r&7 in a &a&lMesa Biome&r&7!
quest.kanto.description.17: &7Each part is randomly obtained from crafting PCs, Healers or Trade Machines. Only the final crafting of the Trade Machine gives &d&lPorygon&r&7 pieces
quest.kanto.description.18: &7Summon the &d&lPorygon&r&7 using your constructed item and capture it
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.1: &7To get your first &a&lProsperity Shard&r&7 you must install a void ore miner.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.2: &7Get a &a&lStack of Infernium&r&7 by killing things.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.8: &7The &a&lProsperity Seed Base&r&7 is the base of every other &a&lMystical Seeds&r&7.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.9: &7The &a&lProsperity Gemstone&r&7 is the base of the other &a&lMystical Gemstone&r&7.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.1: &7The &a&lInferium Gemstone&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lInferium Infusion Crystal&r&7, Armor, Weapon, Tools and the &a&lGrowth Accelerator&r&7.
&7The &a&lPrudentium Gemstone&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lPrudentium Armor&r&7, Weapon, Tools and the &a&lGrowth Accelerator&r&7.
&7The &a&lTertium Gemstone&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lTertium Armor&r&7, Weapon, Tools and the &a&lGrowth Accelerator&r&7.
&7The &a&lImperium Gemstone&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lImperium Armor&r&7, Weapon, Tools and the &a&lGrowth Accelerator&r&7.
&7The &a&lSupremium Gemstone&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lSupremium Armor&r&7, Weapon, Tools and the &a&lGrowth Accelerator&r&7.
&7The &a&lInsanium Gemstone&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lInsanium Armor&r&7, Weapon, Tools and the &a&lGrowth Accelerator&r&7.
&7The &a&lProsperity Ingot&r&7 is the Base of the other &a&lMystical Ingots&r&7.
&7The &a&lInferium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lInferium Furnace&r&7, Armor, Weapon and Tools.
&7The &a&lPrudentium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lPrudentium Furnace&r&7, Armor, Weapon and Tools.
&7The &a&lTertium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lTertium Furnace&r&7, Armor, Weapon and Tools.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.2: &7The &a&lImperium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lImperium Furnace&r&7, Armor, Weapon and Tools.
&7The &a&lSupremium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lSupremium Furnace&r&7, Armor, Weapon and Tools.
&7The &a&lInsanium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lInsanium Furnace&r&7, Armor, Weapon and Tools.
&7The &a&lInferium Farmland&r&7 is an upgraded version of the farmland vanilla.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.3: &7The &a&lPrudentium Farmland&r&7 is an upgraded version of the &a&lInferium Farmland&r&7.
&7The &a&lTertium Farmland&r&7 is an upgraded version of the &a&lPrudentium Farmland&r&7.
&7The &a&lImperium Farmland&r&7 is an upgraded version of the &a&lTertium Farmland&r&7.
&7The &a&lSupremium Farmland&r&7 is an upgraded version of the &a&lImperium Farmland&r&7.
&7The &a&lInsanium Farmland&r&7 is an upgraded version of the &a&lSupremium Farmland&r&7.
&7The &a&lInferium Furnace&r&7 has a &a&lCooking Speed&r&7 of &f&l120&r&7% and &a&lFuel Efficiency&r&7 of &f&l100&r&7%.
&7The &a&lPrudential Furnace&r&7 has a &a&lCooking Speed&r&7 of &f&l160&r&7% and &a&lFuel Efficiency&r&7 of &f&l135&r&7%.
&7The &a&lTertium Furnace&r&7 has a &a&lCooking Speed&r&7 of &f&l250&r&7% and &a&lFuel Efficiency&r&7 of &f&l170&r&7%.
&7The &a&lImperium Furnace&r&7 has a &a&lCooking Speed&r&7 of &f&l690&r&7% and &a&lFuel Efficiency&r&7 of &f&l345&r&7%.
&7The &a&lSupremium Furnace&r&7 has a &a&lCooking Speed&r&7 of &f&l4000&r&7% and &a&lFuel Efficiency&r&7 of &f&l800&r&7%.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.4: &7The &a&lInfusion Altar&r&7 is used to craft &a&lMystical Seeds&r&7.
&7The &a&lSoulium Seed Base&r&7 is used for all mobs seeds.
&7The &a&lSoulium Ingot&r&7 is used to craft the &a&lSeed Reprocessor&r&7, in this pack the &a&lSoulium Dagger&r&7 is useless because all mobs seeds were modified, so be aware.
&7You can get &a&lSoulium Dust&r&7 by mining &a&lSoulium Ore&r&7.
quest.mystical_agriculture.description.5: &7The &a&lInsanium Furnace&r&7 has a &a&lCooking Speed&r&7 of &f&l10000&r&7% and &a&lFuel Efficiency&r&7 of &f&l1000&r&7%.
quest.pixelmon.subtitle.1: With this item you can change your power

quest.pokeballs.description.1: &7You will need this machine to craft the pokeballs
quest.pokeballs.description.4: &7&a&lReverse Repeat Ball&r&7 (Higher chance if &a&lNew Pokedex Entries&r&7)
quest.pokeballs.description.8: &7Summons the pokemon as a Boss on capture
quest.pokeballs.description.9: &7Higher chance catching if &b&lShiny&r&7, turns non &b&lShiny&r&7 captures into &b&lShiny&r&7
quest.pokeballs.description.10: &7Higher chance when not in battle (doesnt work on Legends)
quest.rftools.description.1: &7The &a&lMachine Frame&r&7 is the base of all &b&lRFTools&r&7 machines.
quest.rftools.description.2: &7The &a&lMachine Infuser&r&7 is used to improve the efficiency of lot of machines using &a&lDimensional Shards&r&7.
quest.rftools.description.3: &7The &a&lMatter Transmitter&r&7 is used with a &a&lDialing Device&r&7 to teleport you to a &a&lMatter Receiver&r&7.
quest.rftools.description.4: &7The &a&lMatter Receiver&r&7 is used to create a point of teleportation, place this block anywhere in the world, then you can dial to it using a &a&lDialing Device&r&7.

quest.minions.description.1: &7Every shop the server knows about, in your pocket. Right click it anywhere: the &a&lMinion&r&7 counters live in there, and so does the &a&lMinion Tools&r&7 shop, if you would rather buy a tool than craft it.
quest.minions.description.2: &7Place it, give it a few blocks to work on, and it never stops. &a&lMinions&r&7 are the engine of this whole island.
quest.minions.description.3: &7&f&l160&r&7 cobblestone squeezed into one item. Everything a minion produces ends up here eventually.
quest.minions.description.5: &7The backbone of every machine on the island.
quest.minions.description.6: &7&f&l160&r&7 diamonds. Your minions will get there long before your pickaxe does.
quest.minions.description.7: &7&f&l160&r&7 diamond BLOCKS this time — &f&l1440&r&7 diamonds. The gate to the best minion tools.
quest.minions.description.8: &7Mined by the &a&lMithril Minion&r&7, or bought at the &a&lMinions · Minion Gear&r&7 shop.
quest.minions.description.9: &7Compressed mithril. A late-game currency all by itself.
quest.minions.description.10: &7Slot it into a minion: it compresses the output on the spot, so the minion stops filling its chest with loose blocks.
quest.minions.description.11: &7Speeds a minion up while the sun is out.
quest.minions.description.12: &7Ore in, ingots out, no furnace involved.
quest.minions.description.13: &7The compactor that goes one step further: straight to enchanted items.
quest.minions.description.14: &7Compacts what YOU pick up, not what a minion does.
quest.minions.description.15: &7The last one. Nothing loose ever reaches your inventory again.
quest.minions.description.16: &7The first &a&lMinion&r&7 farming tool. Craft it (recipe in JEI) or buy it at the &a&lMinion Tools&r&7 shop, then work your way up the hoe line.
quest.minions.description.18: &7Third rung. Each tier is built on the one before it, so the cost climbs with the tier — that is deliberate.
quest.minions.description.19: &7The best farming tool in the pack.
quest.minions.description.20: &7The woodcutting equivalent of the hoe line: crafted (recipe in JEI) or bought at the same shop. The Basic and Advanced Gardening Axes come next.
quest.minions.description.22: &7Harvests a whole patch in one swing.
quest.minions.description.23: &7&a&lPixelGO Items&r&7 raise a single IV by one point, up to &f&l31&r&7. They are sold at the &a&lTraining · Stats & Levels&r&7 shop and turn up in structure loot chests.
quest.minions.description.24: &7The rarest of them all: it turns up in the richest structure chests and in &6&lMystery Legendary Bags&r&7, can be built (see JEI), or costs &f&l500 000&r&7 at the &a&lCosmetics · Shiny & Skins&r&7 shop.
quest.minions.description.25: &7The PixelGO balls apply their effect the moment you catch. This one maxes every IV at once.
quest.minions.description.26: &7Catch it, and it is shiny. Build it on the ball line from a &a&lStrong Shiny Lure&r&7, or buy it at the &a&lPoké Balls · Special Balls&r&7 shop for &f&l350 000&r&7 — it works on Legendaries too, so it is priced just under the &a&lShiny Swapper&r&7.
quest.minions.description.27: &7The &a&lMystery Bag&r&7 is sold at the &a&lRewards · Mystery Bags & Cards&r&7 shop. Every bag has a shot at the bag one tier above.
quest.minions.description.28: &7The top bag: the rarest gear in the pack, the five rarest &a&lMinion&r&7 enchantment books, and a Legendary Pokédoll one time in four.
